decision_basis: Two independent Docker canonical-build cycles produced the same zte_tpd.ko SHA-256.
Candidate and stock AArch64 assembly have identical 67 instructions, 268-byte symbol size and resolved relocations.
Candidate and stock KCFI type IDs are identical: 0xc3d43b4d.
Strict Joern gate passed with zero parse problems and one-to-one source/Ghidra identity coverage using the recorded compatibility defines.
The dedicated ASAN/UBSAN contract passed 4/4 cases in both reproducible cycles, covering valid writes, nine-byte cap, invalid input and no-callback behavior.
review_findings: Joern retains one high-severity userspace-ingress finding.
